sentence: This project studies how the genes of parasitic orchids changed after they stopped photosynthesis and came to depend on specific fungi.
This project builds a standard way to measure which proteins refold after unfolding and uses it to study why proteins misfold.
This project designs techniques that let solvers handle much larger strategic interactions where players lack full information, including when only a simulator is available.
This project combines deep learning with wave simulations to image hidden properties when there is little labeled data.
This project builds a test that measures inflammatory proteins in a drop of whole blood to help spot infections after surgery.
This project studies which viruses infect which ocean bacteria and how those infections shape their communities over seasons and years.
This project builds a system that automatically finds abnormal events in data collected over time and explains them in plain language.
This project holds a series of conferences where researchers discuss quantum symmetry, which is used in the mathematics that models quantum behavior.
This project sets up a lab where instruments run by robots and AI carry out experiments on biology, chemistry, and metal alloys.
This project tries to find ways to grow animal muscle and fat from stem cells in a plant-based medium and shape them into three-dimensional tissue.
This project studies why some marine fish cross a strong ocean boundary as waters warm while others do not.
This project measures trace elements in aerosol particles and how much of them is delivered to the surface ocean.
This project studies how genes and the environment together decide whether field crickets grow long wings or short wings.
This project tries to find unknown kinds of non-coding RNA by testing which RNA binding proteins stick to them and by analyzing the results by computer.
This project builds methods that let wireless systems reuse what they have learned to share limited spectrum more efficiently and securely.
This project builds a cybersecurity course with hands-on labs about the security of physical devices that connect to a network.
